title: 経路比較(B/D)
concept: 生成経路の比較検証用(非公開)。3キャラ(餡音・イズナ・ナルカ)で B: Ref2VA と D: Ref2VA+AddGuide(1フレーム目固定) を同条件で生成し、声の一致・リップシンク・トーン・構図を比べる。ep000_sakuya-engawa の続き。

cuts.h3_prompt:
Clean anime cel illustration, keep the exact same clean line art, light soft cel shading and character coloring of the input image throughout. Elegant Japanese dark fantasy: deep indigo-black night (#16162a), gold accents only as thin lines and tiny drifting particles (maki-e lacquerware feeling), dark-purple night sakura, silver mist. Do not change the character design or art style.

Scene: A cheerful girl with short brown hair tied up in a small topknot, straight bangs, soft dark-gray eyes, wearing a long-sleeved moss-green kimono-style tunic with black collar and cuffs, a dark green obi tied in a bow, a thick chunky red knitted scarf with fringe, black tights and black tabi boots. She stands under the dark wooden eaves of a closed old teahouse at night, warm dim light from a paper window behind her, a dark-purple night sakura branch hanging over the eaves, a few petals drifting.

Motion storyboard:
[0s-3s] She stands facing slightly away in three-quarter view, gazing at the drifting petals, swaying a little in a relaxed, easygoing way, calm breathing.
[3s-5s] She notices someone, turns her head and upper body toward the camera, her face brightening into a smile.
[5s-9s] She tilts her head happily and clasps her hands in front of her chest, and at 5.5s says in Japanese in a bright, relaxed, easygoing young girl's voice with slow drawn-out word endings, with natural falling intonation: 「おなかすいたねえ。お団子、食べようよう」
[9s-10s] She holds the smile, a few gold particles drift past.

Camera: static medium shot (knees up), very slight slow push-in.

Audio: quiet night ambience, soft rustle of the wind, a faint low bell far away, a calm koto-like melody underneath. Her line 「おなかすいたねえ。お団子、食べようよう」 at 5.5s, close and clear.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Keep the clean anime cel look from the first frame to the last frame, no bright festival red, no pale pink or white sakura, no blue sky, no daytime, no white background, do not become photorealistic, do not change the character design.
cuts.dialogue: 5.5s 「おなかすいたねえ。お団子、食べようよう」
